title: Age of Disclosure documentary: US holds craft and alien bodies

tellings.quote: Speaking of extremely advanced technology, a documentary just came out of the United States where you had a former CIA director, Brennan, and former director of national intelligence, James Clapper, and you had a whole host of intelligence officials, um, quoted people like David Grush, who was, you know, former national geospatial agency, a bunch of people down the line saying that the US is not only involved than UFO research, but they have uh materials and they have saucers and crafts and hangers where they're working on reverse engineering these UFOs and they have alien bodies as well that they've recovered alongside these crafts.
They're saying we have like, you know, decades long like, you know, multigenerational crash retrievals.
tellings.difference: Frames it as decades-long, multigenerational crash retrievals and ties it to Area 51.
tellings.link_reason: Clapper and Brennan in The Age of Disclosure backing the claim that the US holds recovered craft is the same documentary claim as this story.

as_told.title: Clapper and Brennan in The Age of Disclosure: multigenerational crash retrievals

plain: A documentary called The Age of Disclosure features former CIA director John Brennan, former director of national intelligence James Clapper and other intelligence officials. Among them is David Grusch, formerly of the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, and according to Michels the film carries claims that the US holds saucers and other craft in hangars, is working on "reverse engineering" them (taking them apart to learn how they work), and has recovered alien bodies along with them. Michels tells this himself, and in a later episode describes the claim as "decades long, multigenerational crash retrievals" tied to Area 51, the secret military test site in Nevada.
